subject: general
question: Which of the following is an important safety measure during a power failure?

options.text: Continuing to use equipment without verifying power status
Ensuring all machines and electrical equipment are turned off

solution:
The correct answer is __Ensuring all machines and electrical equipment are turned off__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ensuring all machines and electrical equipment are turned off__ is an essential safety measure during a power failure.
 
• Turning off all equipment prevents potential damage when power is restored.
 
• It helps avoid electrical surges that can occur during power restoration.
 
• Ensuring machines are off minimizes fire hazards and other risks.
 
• Proper handling during power failures is crucial for personal safety and equipment longevity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Using candles for lighting:**
 
 
• While candles can provide temporary light, they pose fire hazards if not handled carefully.
 
 
 
• **Continuing to use equipment without verifying power status:**
 
 
• This can lead to equipment damage or malfunction.
 
 
 
• **Ignoring alarm systems:**
 
 
• Alarm systems provide critical alerts and should not be ignored during power failures.
